candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of opposition, conflict, or taking a stance against something.

This feature vector represents the concepts of law, legislation, and the legal or parliamentary system.
This feature activates for past-tense action verbs describing deliberate transitive acts and achievements.

This vector represents restrictive adverbs and words of temporal continuity or emphasis across multiple languages.
These tokens represent common suffixes used for noun and adverb formation across multiple Romance languages.
